# System packages for Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04 (and Debian bookworm+) when building
# Python with pyenv or compiling C extensions during `pip install`.
#
# Usage:
#   sudo apt-get update
#   sudo apt-get install -y $(grep -v '^#' deps/ubuntu.txt | tr '\n' ' ')
#
# Or: ./scripts/install-system-deps.sh
#
# Prefer distro Python 3.12 when available:
#   sudo apt-get install -y python3.12 python3.12-venv python3.12-dev

git
curl
build-essential
libssl-dev
zlib1g-dev
libbz2-dev
libreadline-dev
libsqlite3-dev
libffi-dev
liblzma-dev
# Prefer the distro interpreter when it is >=3.11
python3
python3-venv
python3-dev
python3-pip
docker.io
